## How I checked it

- [ ] The title and every commit follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` …)

- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has a line under Unreleased for user-visible changes
- [ ] For visual changes: screenshots from `npm run preview` are attached
- [ ] Docs updated (README parameters or styles table) if behaviour changed
